findings.bug: Comment and ARCHITECTURE/C03 claim cancellation kills the Blender process tree; implementation is bare exec.CommandContext with no Setpgid/process-group kill. TestSmokeCancel only asserts parent error, not child-tree exit.
findings.predicted: Timeout/cancel (and CLI SIGINT) can leave orphan Blender/render children holding GPU/CPU and writing into a job dir after the parent already returned failure.
findings.fix_hint: Start Blender in its own process group and kill the group on ctx Done; assert no live descendants in timeout+cancel tests.

findings.bug: preview/render/smoke use context.Background() with no os/signal wiring; Ctrl+C kills blendctl without cooperative cancel of Run/RunApply.
findings.predicted: Interactive cancel leaves Blender running against the job tree; subsequent agents may see late PNGs or a half-written scene.blend with no failed marker update.
findings.fix_hint: Propagate a signal-notified context into RunApply/RunSmoke so cancel takes the same path as Timeout.

findings.bug: Render success only requires len(frames)>0; never checks inclusive decl frame_end-frame_start+1 or expected frame_NNNN.png names. Cancel mid-loop already leaves partial frames + scene.blend (saved before the render loop in apply_scene.py).
findings.predicted: Any exit-0 with a non-empty subset (or agents that trust PNG/.blend presence over manifests) treats incomplete shot output as finished; C03/C06 poison remains in the job out/ tree.
findings.fix_hint: Require exact expected frame set before WriteSuccessManifest; on failure keep failed marker and document that PNG/.blend alone are not success.

findings.bug: Phase 4 plan and RUN-03 claim timeout honesty; suite only has immediate cancel. Playbook run marks C03 PASS via cancel alone — timeout path unexercised.
findings.predicted: DeadlineExceeded mis-reporting or hung CombinedOutput after kill stays latent until production long renders.
findings.fix_hint: Add a short artificial Timeout fixture that asserts timed-out error, no manifest.json, and process-group gone.

findings.bug: If WriteSuccessManifest fails after Blender produced frames/PNG, RunApply returns error without WriteFailedMarker; early extract/compile failures after JobDir create also leave unmarked orphan trees.
findings.predicted: Disk-full or permission errors yield ambiguous job dirs: real frames, no complete manifest, no failed marker — recovery heuristics diverge.
findings.fix_hint: On any post-jobDir failure path, always WriteFailedMarker (best-effort) before returning; never leave success-looking bytes without a terminal status file.

findings.bug: dependencies.json is written only after RunApply success with `_, _ = WriteDependencyManifest(...)` — errors discarded; crash between manifest.json and dependencies.json leaves SHOT-02 provenance missing on an otherwise complete job.
findings.predicted: Shot isolation/hash audits and agent handoffs see complete renders without dependency digests; concurrent retries cannot prove input snapshot.
findings.fix_hint: Write dependencies inside RunApply before advertising success (or fail the job if provenance write fails).

findings.bug: compile writes script then data straight into user --out; ARCHITECTURE nonempty-refuse/overwrite flag never implemented. Crash mid-write leaves mixed generations in the destination.
findings.predicted: Retry or agent validate against a half-updated out/ pairs new data with old script (or vice versa) and looks like a valid compile.
findings.fix_hint: Stage to a temp dir and rename into --out, or refuse nonempty destinations without an explicit overwrite mode.

findings.bug: Unique moblend-job-* dirs under --out accumulate forever; no retention, current symlink, or failed-tree scrub. Plan deferred hostile delete correctly but shipped no bounded cleanup policy.
findings.predicted: Repeated shot previews fill disk; consumers scanning DIR/<shot>/* pick a stale complete job beside a newer failed one.
findings.fix_hint: Emit a stable latest pointer atomically and document retention; optional --keep-failed only.
